g.text: MMU: is the entry for A's
read it from disk, map it
run it again: this time the entry is valid
zero-filled, or from the page cache, or shared, or copy-on-write
from a file, or from swap: milliseconds, not microseconds
minor and major, the two ways a fault is fixed:
One hardware event, four verdicts. The hardware only knows the table; the list of zones is what lets the kernel decide.
